messages:
marta-support: Customer (Acme Health) says their DPA erasure request showed 'completed' in UI but audit logs show retained objects and KMS key rotation coincided. They want proof of deletion and an ETA. :eyes:
jason-security: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the deletion request id and the tenant id? Also did we see any failed KMS calls around the rotation window? :lock:
marta-support: Request id: erasure-2026-03-12-ACME-42, tenant: acme-health-01. Customer attached a screenshot claiming API returned 200 but files persist. No obvious 5xx in their logs. They reported a spike in deletion latency ~03/12 03:10 UTC.
oliver-eng: Ok. I need the backend trace id if available. Ask customer to export our audit bundle: `redwood-audit export --tenant acme-health-01 --since 2026-03-12T02:50:00Z --until 2026-03-12T03:30:00Z --include-kms` and share the bundle link. That will show object tombstone events + KMS decrypt/verify calls.
marta-support: Sent instructions. They returned a link to the bundle (pending). In the meantime, timeline note: we rotated KMS key for the cluster in region eu-west-1 03/12 03:05 UTC (key id: rk-euw1-9a8b). Confirmed by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy:rotation rk-euw1-9a8b applied to service storage-gw-1 at 2026-03-12T03:05:12Z (hash: d4f7c2).
jason-security: If rotation occurred during in-flight deletes, we should check whether HSM wrap/unwrap errors caused the storage gateway to fall back to soft-delete behavior. Emily, any policy impact from rotation w.r.t retention proofs?
emily-privacy: Rotation alone shouldn't prevent deletion proof if tombstones were written. But legal needs an auditable chain: delete request -> tombstone event -> key unwrap success -> object zeroed/purged. We need the audit events and KMS call results. If those KMS calls errored and were retried, we must show retries and final outcome.
marta-support: Customer's quote: "API returned 200, but a later re-check shows files still accessible via signed URL." They asked for immediate account-level evidence to prove data removed or identify rollback.
oliver-eng: Preliminary check: timeline suggests a small window where storage-gw logged `kms:Decrypt` latency spiking to 15s and some `ERROR: KMS_UNWRAP_TIMEOUT`. Those map to a transient HSM network blip in euw1 cluster. If true, some deletion flows may have aborted and left items in soft-delete state. I'll pull the object state table for tenant.
jason-security: Raise INC-2026-042 for this. Need SRE to validate HSM network and whether any key material was temporarily unavailable. Also confirm subprocessor scope — we relied on third-party HSM provider; we should list that in evidence for customer.
marta-support: Customer needs an evidence packet for DPA: include audit bundle, KMS call logs (with key ids), list of subprocessors, and explicit statement of what happened and remediation steps. Legal asked for a one-page summary + raw logs.
emily-privacy: Draft language suggestion: "On 2026-03-12 03:05 UTC a scheduled KMS key rotation coincided with a transient HSM network degradation. Some delete operations retried and in a small percentage did not progress to permanent purge within our standard window. We remediated by re-running purge tasks and reissuing KMS unwraps. Attached are audit logs showing final purge timestamps and KMS success codes." Keep it factual, include IDs and timestamps.
oliver-eng: Action items for support thread: 1) Customer to share audit bundle (done/pending). 2) Engineering to export object states + purge job runs for acme-health-01 between 03:00-04:00 UTC. 3) Security to produce subprocessor list and HSM incident summary. 4) Privacy to assemble customer-facing evidence and timeline. I'll start object_state export now: `SELECT object_id, state, last_transition, purge_job_id FROM object_state WHERE tenant='acme-health-01' AND last_transition >= '2026-03-12T03:00:00Z'`
marta-support: Copied to customer and escalated to Priority SEs. Customer asked for ETA on evidence pack — legal wants it within 48h.
jason-security: We'll aim 24h for internal evidence, 48h for customer-ready pack. Noted for INC-2026-042.
dpa-bot: DPA_NOTIFY: erasure_request erasure-2026-03-12-ACME-42 state=escalated incident=INC-2026-042 assigned=[jason-security, emily-privacy, oliver-eng] timestamp=2026-03-12T05:12:09Z
marta-support: Thanks team. Will update ACME with interim status: we are investigating KMS/HSM overlap with deletion flows, collecting audit logs and purge job traces, ETA 48h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
emily-privacy: I'll draft the customer statement and attach required log extracts once oliver posts the object_state export.
oliver-eng: Uploaded object_state export to secure-share (link withheld). Key findings: ~0.6% of delete flows showed `PURGE_PENDING` for >10m due to `KMS_UNWRAP_TIMEOUT`. I've triggered a forced purge run and those items transitioned to `PURGED` at 2026-03-12T03:42:11Z. Will attach the purge_job logs.
marta-support: Customer confirmed they see the previously accessible signed URLs return 404 after our forced purge. They requested the explicit purge timestamps for each object. Sending now. :white_check_mark:
